title: feat(nsnnzinc): nnseed z-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on nnseed z-probes; union is a no-op at A (L(A)=+e3 already a neighbour lock). Face holds from -e1/+e1 at C/D; reverse fails on {+e1,+e3} vs {+e1,+e3}. The note correctly separates the two bits' timing needs: reverse needs the global later tick, face does not.
